then.say: Oh, don't stop on my account. Or do, and listen. Wren. I play for whoever comes up the road.
Most of them don't come back down it, so I play them in. It seems only polite.

do.say: 'The Wick Burns Low'. Pilgrims used to sing it on the hill. There were words once. Nobody remembers them now.
I think they were happy words. The tune doesn't sound it, does it?
Everywhere with a road. I came for the Abbey's feast day. The feast never came, and the road out got long.

then.say: I've been learning a new tune. Something for after. It's still missing an ending.

else.say: I'll be here. Follow the harp home if you lose your way.
